what: cutting the complete circular top face of a widening conical frustum inward: the cylindrical tool touches the cone only at its rim
method: frustum r 1 (bottom) -> 5 (top) over 10 mm (slope 0.4); removing the top 4.4 mm leaves height 5.6 with radii 1 and 1+0.4*5.6 = 3.24: V = pi*h*(r0^2 + r0*r1 + r1^2)/3 = pi*5.6*(1 + 3.24 + 3.24^2)/3. Faces: cone wall, bottom disc, new top disc = 3; bbox z 0..5.6
